package db

import (
	"database/sql"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestCreateGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	db, _ := sql.Open("sqlite3", ":memory:")
	defer db.Close()

	g := &Grocery{Name: "Apples", Quantity: 10}
	err := g.Create(db)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	var count int
	db.QueryRow("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groceries").Scan(&count)
	assert.Equal(t, 1, count)
}

func TestUpdateGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	db, _ := sql.Open("sqlite3", ":memory:")
	defer db.Close()

	g := &Grocery{Name: "Apples", Quantity: 10}
	err := g.Create(db)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	g.Quantity = 20
	err = g.Update(db)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	var updatedQuantity int
	db.QueryRow("SELECT quantity FROM groceries WHERE id = $1", g.ID).Scan(&updatedQuantity)
	assert.Equal(t, 20, updatedQuantity)
}

func TestGetGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	db, _ := sql.Open("sqlite3", ":memory:")
	defer db.Close()

	g := &Grocery{Name: "Apples", Quantity: 10}
	err := g.Create(db)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	var dbGrocery Grocery
	db.Get(&dbGrocery, "SELECT id, name, quantity, created_at, updated_at FROM groceries WHERE id = $1", g.ID)
	assert.Equal(t, g.ID, dbGrocery.ID)
	assert.Equal(t, g.Name, dbGrocery.Name)
	assert.Equal(t, g.Quantity, dbGrocery.Quantity)
}

func TestDeleteGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	db, _ := sql.Open("sqlite3", ":memory:")

	err = g.Delete(db)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	var count int
	db.QueryRow("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM groceries WHERE id = $1", g.ID).Scan(&count)
	assert.Equal(t, 0, count)
}

package handlers

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt"

	"github.com/mikefrancis/garage/db"
)

func mockDB() *sql.DB {
	db, _ := sql.Open("mock", "file::memory:?mode=memory")
	return db
}

func TestGetGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	db := mockDB()
	defer db.Close()

	rows := sqlmock.NewRows([]string{"id", "name", "quantity", "created_at", "updated_at"}).
		AddRow(1, "apple", 2, "2023-04-01 12:00:00", "2023-04-01 12:00:00")
	mock.ExpectQuery("SELECT id, name, quantity, created_at, updated_at FROM groceries WHERE id = \\?").WithArgs(1).WillReturnRows(rows)

	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Use(middleware.RequestID)
	router.Get("/groceries/{id}", GetGrocery)

	req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", "/groceries/1", nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, resp.Code)
	var g db.Grocery
	err = json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&g)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, db.Grocery{ID: 1, Name: "apple", Quantity: 2}, g)
}

func TestListGroceries(t *testing.T) {
	db := mockDB()
	defer db.Close()

	rows := sqlmock.NewRows([]string{"id", "name", "quantity", "created_at", "updated_at"}).
		AddRow(1, "apple", 2, "2023-04-01 12:00:00", "2023-04-01 12:00:00").
		AddRow(2, "banana", 5, "2023-04-01 13:00:00", "2023-04-01 13:00:00")
	mock.ExpectQuery("SELECT id, name, quantity, created_at, updated_at FROM groceries").WillReturnRows(rows)

	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Use(middleware.RequestID)
	router.Get("/groceries", ListGroceries)

	req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", "/groceries", nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, resp.Code)
	var gs []db.Grocery
	err = json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&gs)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, []db.Grocery{
		{ID: 1, Name: "apple", Quantity: 2},
		{ID: 2, Name: "banana", Quantity: 5},
	}, gs)
}

func TestCreateGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	db := mockDB()
	defer db.Close()

	rows := sqlmock.NewRows([]string{"id", "name", "quantity", "created_at", "updated_at"}).
		AddRow(1, "apple", 2, "2023-04-01 12:00:00", "2023-04-01 12:00:00")
	mock.ExpectQuery("INSERT INTO groceries \\(name, quantity\\) VALUES \\(\\?, \\?\\) RETURNING id, name, quantity, created_at, updated_at").WithArgs("apple", 2).WillReturnRows(rows)

	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Use(middleware.RequestID)

	if err != nil {

	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusCreated, resp.Code)
	var g db.Grocery
	err = json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&g)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, db.Grocery{ID: 1, Name: "apple", Quantity: 2}, g)
}

func TestUpdateGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	db := mockDB()
	defer db.Close()

	router := chi.NewRouter()

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, resp.Code)
	var g db.Grocery
	err = json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&g)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, db.Grocery{ID: 1, Name: "apple", Quantity: 3}, g)

	db := mockDB()
	defer db.Close()

	router.Use(middleware.RequestID)
	router.Delete("/groceries/{id}", DeleteGrocery)

	req, err := http.NewRequest("DELETE", "/groceries/1", nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	resp := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(resp, req)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusNoContent, resp.Code)
}

package main

import (
    "context"
    "database/sql"
    "net/http"
    "os"
    "github.com/jackc/pgx/v4"
    "handlers"
)

func main() {
    port := os.Getenv("PORT")
    if port == "" {
        port = "8080"
    }

    db, err := pgx.Connect(context.Background(), os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL"))
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    defer db.Close(context.Background())

    mux := http.NewServeMux()
    mux.HandleFunc("/groceries", handlers.ListGroceries)

    mux.HandleFunc("/groceries", handlers.CreateGrocery)
    mux.HandleFunc("/groceries/", handlers.UpdateGrocery)
    mux.HandleFunc("/groceries/", handlers.DeleteGrocery)

    http.ListenAndServe(":"+port, mux)
}

package handlers

import (
	"bytes"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"

)

func TestListGroceries(t *testing.T) {
	db := dbtest.Setup()
	defer db.Close()

	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.GET("/groceries", ListGroceries)

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", "/groceries", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	r.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, rec.Code)
	var response struct {
		Groceries []*struct {
			ID        int
			Name      string
			Quantity  int
			CreatedAt time.Time
			UpdatedAt time.Time
		}
	}
	err := json.NewDecoder(rec.Body).Decode(&response)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Len(t, response.Groceries, 0) // No groceries initially
}

func TestGetGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	db := dbtest.Setup()
	defer db.Close()

	groceryID := addGrocery(db, "Strawberry", 5)

	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Get("/groceries/{id}", GetGrocery)

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", "/groceries/"+strconv.Itoa(groceryID), nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	r.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, rec.Code)
	var response struct {
		ID        int
		Name      string
		Quantity  int
		CreatedAt time.Time
		UpdatedAt time.Time
	}
	err := json.NewDecoder(rec.Body).Decode(&response)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, groceryID, response.ID)
	assert.Equal(t, "Strawberry", response.Name)
	assert.Equal(t, 5, response.Quantity)
}

func TestCreateGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	db := dbtest.Setup()
	defer db.Close()

	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Post("/groceries", CreateGrocery)

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "/groceries", bytes.NewBuffer([]byte(`{"name": "Blueberry", "quantity": 8}`)))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	r.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusCreated, rec.Code)
	var response struct {
		ID        int
		Name      string
		Quantity  int
		CreatedAt time.Time
		UpdatedAt time.Time
	}
	err := json.NewDecoder(rec.Body).Decode(&response)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.NotEqual(t, 0, response.ID)
	assert.Equal(t, "Blueberry", response.Name)
	assert.Equal(t, 8, response.Quantity)
}

func TestUpdateGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	db := dbtest.Setup()
	defer db.Close()

	groceryID := addGrocery(db, "Grape", 10)

	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Put("/groceries/{id}", UpdateGrocery)

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("PUT", "/groceries/"+strconv.Itoa(groceryID), bytes.NewBuffer([]byte(`{"name": "Kiwi", "quantity": 12}`)))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	r.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, rec.Code)
	var response struct {
		ID        int
		Name      string
		Quantity  int
		CreatedAt time.Time
		UpdatedAt time.Time
	}
	err := json.NewDecoder(rec.Body).Decode(&response)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, groceryID, response.ID)
	assert.Equal(t, "Kiwi", response.Name)
	assert.Equal(t, 12, response.Quantity)
}

func TestDeleteGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	db := dbtest.Setup()
	defer db.Close()

	groceryID := addGrocery(db, "Mango", 15)

	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Delete("/groceries/{id}", DeleteGrocery)

	req, _ := http.NewRequest("DELETE", "/groceries/"+strconv.Itoa(groceryID), nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	r.ServeHTTP(rec, req)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, rec.Code)
	var response map[string]interface{}
	err := json.NewDecoder(rec.Body).Decode(&response)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, "success", response["status"])
}

func addGrocery(db *sql.DB, name string, quantity int) int {
	result, err := db.Exec("INSERT INTO groceries (name, quantity) VALUES ($1, $2) RETURNING id", name, quantity)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	id, _ := result.LastInsertId()
	return int(id)
}

package main

import (
	"fmt"

)

func main() {

	if port == "" {
		port = "8080"
	}

	dbPath := ":memory:"
	handler, err := handlers.NewGroceryHandler(dbPath)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}

	router := httprouter.New()
	router.GET("/groceries", handler.List)
	router.GET("/groceries/:id", handler.Get)
	router.POST("/groceries", handler.Create)
	router.PUT("/groceries/:id", handler.Update)
	router.DELETE("/groceries/:id", handler.Delete)

	fmt.Printf("Starting server on port %s\n", port)
	log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe(fmt.Sprintf(":%s", port), router))
}

package db

import (
	"database/sql"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type Grocery struct {
	ID        int       `json:"id"`
	Name      string    `json:"name"`
	Quantity  int       `json:"quantity"`
	CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

func CreateGrocery(db *sql.DB, name string, quantity int) (*Grocery, error) {
	query := `
		INSERT INTO groceries (name, quantity)
		VALUES ($1, $2)
		RETURNING id, created_at, updated_at
	`
	var grocery Grocery
	err := db.QueryRow(query, name, quantity).Scan(&grocery.ID, &grocery.CreatedAt, &grocery.UpdatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	grocery.Name = name
	grocery.Quantity = quantity
	return &grocery, nil
}

func GetGrocery(db *sql.DB, id int) (*Grocery, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT id, name, quantity, created_at, updated_at
		FROM groceries
		WHERE id = $1
	`
	var grocery Grocery
	err := db.QueryRow(query, id).Scan(&grocery.ID, &grocery.Name, &grocery.Quantity, &grocery.CreatedAt, &grocery.UpdatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &grocery, nil
}

func ListGroceries(db *sql.DB) ([]*Grocery, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT id, name, quantity, created_at, updated_at
		FROM groceries
	`
	rows, err := db.Query(query)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var groceries []*Grocery
	for rows.Next() {
		var grocery Grocery
		err := rows.Scan(&grocery.ID, &grocery.Name, &grocery.Quantity, &grocery.CreatedAt, &grocery.UpdatedAt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		groceries = append(groceries, &grocery)
	}
	return groceries, nil
}

func UpdateGrocery(db *sql.DB, id int, name string, quantity int) (*Grocery, error) {
	query := `
		UPDATE groceries
		SET name = $1, quantity = $2, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
		WHERE id = $3
		RETURNING created_at, updated_at
	`
	var grocery Grocery
	err := db.QueryRow(query, name, quantity, id).Scan(&grocery.CreatedAt, &grocery.UpdatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	grocery.ID = id
	grocery.Name = name
	grocery.Quantity = quantity
	return &grocery, nil
}

func DeleteGrocery(db *sql.DB, id int) error {
	query := `
		DELETE FROM groceries
		WHERE id = $1
	`
	_, err := db.Exec(query, id)
	return err
}

package main

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"

	"github.com/julienschmidt/httprouter"
	"go.uber.org/zap"
	"yourapp/db"
	"yourapp/handlers"
)

func main() {
	port := os.Getenv("PORT")
	if port == "" {
		port = "8080"
	}

	log, _ := zap.NewProduction()
	defer log.Sync()

	db, err := db.NewDB("user=postgres dbname=test sslmode=disable")
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer db.Close()

	h := handlers.NewGroceriesHandler(db, log.Sugar())

	router := httprouter.New()
	router.POST("/groceries", h.Create)
	router.GET("/groceries/:id", h.Get)
	router.GET("/groceries", h.List)
	router.PUT("/groceries/:id", h.Update)
	router.DELETE("/groceries/:id", h.Delete)

	log.Info("Starting server on port " + port)
	if err := http.ListenAndServe(":"+port, router); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}

package main

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"

	"github.com/julienschmidt/httprouter"
	"grocery-store/db"
	"grocery-store/handlers"
)

func main() {
	port := os.Getenv("PORT")
	if port == "" {
		port = "8080"
	}

	router := httprouter.New()
	db, err := db.NewDB(os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("Failed to connect to database: %v", err)
	}
	defer db.Close()

	groceriesHandler := handlers.NewGroceriesHandler(db)

	router.GET("/groceries", groceriesHandler.List)
	router.GET("/groceries/:id", groceriesHandler.GetByID)
	router.POST("/groceries", groceriesHandler.Create)
	router.PUT("/groceries/:id", groceriesHandler.UpdateByID)
	router.DELETE("/groceries/:id", groceriesHandler.DeleteByID)

	log.Printf("Starting server on :%s", port)
	log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe(":"+port, router))
}

	// Create a new GroceryDB

	require.NoError(t, err)

	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, 1, len(groceries))
	assert.Equal(t, "milk", groceries[0].Name)
	assert.Equal(t, 2, groceries[0].Quantity)
}

func TestGroceryDB_Get(t *testing.T) {
	db, err := sql.Open("postgres", "postgres://localhost:5432/test?sslmode=disable")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer db.Close()

	groceryDB := NewGroceryDB(db)

	// Insert a test grocery
	grocery, err := groceryDB.Create(context.Background(), "bread", 3)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	// Get the grocery by ID
	got, err := groceryDB.Get(context.Background(), grocery.ID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, grocery.ID, got.ID)
	assert.Equal(t, "bread", got.Name)
	assert.Equal(t, 3, got.Quantity)
}

func TestGroceryDB_Create(t *testing.T) {
	db, err := sql.Open("postgres", "postgres://localhost:5432/test?sslmode=disable")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer db.Close()

	groceryDB := NewGroceryDB(db)

	// Create a new grocery
	grocery, err := groceryDB.Create(context.Background(), "eggs", 12)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, 12, grocery.Quantity)
	assert.NotZero(t, grocery.CreatedAt)
	assert.NotZero(t, grocery.UpdatedAt)
}

func TestGroceryDB_Update(t *testing.T) {
	db, err := sql.Open("postgres", "postgres://localhost:5432/test?sslmode=disable")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer db.Close()

	groceryDB := NewGroceryDB(db)

	// Create a grocery
	created, err := groceryDB.Create(context.Background(), "apples", 5)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	// Update the grocery
	updated, err := groceryDB.Update(context.Background(), created.ID, "oranges", 8)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, 8, updated.Quantity)
}

func TestGroceryDB_Delete(t *testing.T) {
	db, err := sql.Open("postgres", "postgres://localhost:5432/test?sslmode=disable")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	defer db.Close()

	require.NoError(t, err)

	_, err = groceryDB.Get(context.Background(), created.ID)
	assert.Error(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, sql.ErrNoRows, err)
}

package db

import (
	"database/sql"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestGroceryCRUD(t *testing.T) {
	db := setupTestDB()
	defer db.Close()

	g := &Grocery{Name: "Milk", Quantity: 2}
	assert.NoError(t, g.Create(db))

	assert.NoError(t, g.Get(db))
	assert.Equal(t, "Milk", g.Name)
	assert.Equal(t, 2, g.Quantity)

	g.Name = "Cheese"
	g.Quantity = 1
	assert.NoError(t, g.Update(db))

	assert.NoError(t, g.Get(db))
	assert.Equal(t, "Cheese", g.Name)
	assert.Equal(t, 1, g.Quantity)

	assert.NoError(t, g.Delete(db))
	assert.Error(t, g.Get(db))
}

func TestListGroceries(t *testing.T) {
	db := setupTestDB()
	defer db.Close()

	g1 := &Grocery{Name: "Eggs", Quantity: 12}
	assert.NoError(t, g1.Create(db))

	g2 := &Grocery{Name: "Bread", Quantity: 3}
	assert.NoError(t, g2.Create(db))

	groceries, err := ListGroceries(db)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Len(t, groceries, 2)
}

func setupTestDB() *sql.DB {
	db, _ := sql.Open("postgres", "user=postgres dbname=testdb sslmode=disable")
	db.Exec("CREATE TABLE groceries (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, quantity INTEGER DEFAULT 0, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW())")
	return db
}

package db

import (
	"reflect"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestDB_GetAllGroceries(t *testing.T) {
	db := NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()

	groceries, err := db.GetAllGroceries()
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.NotNil(t, groceries)
	assert.Len(t, groceries, 0)
}

func TestDB_GetGroceryByID(t *testing.T) {
	db := NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()

	_, err := db.GetGroceryByID(1)
	assert.Error(t, err)
}

func TestDB_CreateGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	db := NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()

	grocery, err := db.CreateGrocery("apples", 5)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.NotNil(t, grocery)
	assert.Equal(t, "apples", grocery.Name)
	assert.Equal(t, 5, grocery.Quantity)
	assert.True(t, grocery.CreatedAt.After(time.Now().Add(-time.Second)))
	assert.True(t, grocery.UpdatedAt.After(time.Now().Add(-time.Second)))
}

func TestDB_UpdateGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	db := NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()

	// Create a grocery first
	grocery, err := db.CreateGrocery("apples", 5)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	// Update it
	updatedGrocery, err := db.UpdateGrocery(grocery.ID, "bananas", 10)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.NotNil(t, updatedGrocery)
	assert.Equal(t, "bananas", updatedGrocery.Name)
	assert.Equal(t, 10, updatedGrocery.Quantity)
	assert.Equal(t, grocery.ID, updatedGrocery.ID)
}

func TestDB_DeleteGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	db := NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()

	// Create a grocery first
	grocery, err := db.CreateGrocery("apples", 5)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	// Delete it
	err = db.DeleteGrocery(grocery.ID)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	// Verify it's gone
	_, err = db.GetGroceryByID(grocery.ID)
	assert.Error(t, err)
}

func TestDB_GetAllGroceriesWithMultipleEntries(t *testing.T) {
	db := NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()

	// Create multiple groceries
	_, err := db.CreateGrocery("apples", 5)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	_, err = db.CreateGrocery("bananas", 3)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	groceries, err := db.GetAllGroceries()
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Len(t, groceries, 2)

	// Check that we get the right data back
	names := []string{groceries[0].Name, groceries[1].Name}
	quantities := []int{groceries[0].Quantity, groceries[1].Quantity}

	assert.Contains(t, names, "apples")
	assert.Contains(t, names, "bananas")
	assert.Contains(t, quantities, 5)
	assert.Contains(t, quantities, 3)
}

	assert.NoError(t, err)

	rr := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.GetAllGroceries(rr, req)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, rr.Code)

	var response []GroceryResponse
	err = json.Unmarshal(rr.Body.Bytes(), &response)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Len(t, response, 0)
}

func TestHandler_GetGroceryByID(t *testing.T) {
	handler := NewTestHandler(t)
	defer handler.DB.Close()

	req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", "/groceries/1", nil)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusNotFound, rr.Code)

	assert.Equal(t, 5, response.Quantity)
	assert.True(t, strings.Contains(response.CreatedAt, "T"))
	assert.True(t, strings.Contains(response.UpdatedAt, "T"))
}

func TestHandler_UpdateGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	handler := NewTestHandler(t)
	defer handler.DB.Close()

	// First create a grocery
	payload := map[string]interface{}{
		"name":     "apples",
		"quantity": 5,
	}
	jsonPayload, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	createReq, err := http.NewRequest("POST", "/groceries", bytes.NewBuffer(jsonPayload))

	assert.NoError(t, err)

	updateReq, err := http.NewRequest("PUT", "/groceries/"+string(rune(createdResponse.ID)), bytes.NewBuffer(jsonUpdatePayload))
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	updateReq.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	rr = httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.UpdateGrocery(rr, updateReq)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, rr.Code)

	var response GroceryResponse
	err = json.Unmarshal(rr.Body.Bytes(), &response)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, "bananas", response.Name)
	assert.Equal(t, 10, response.Quantity)
}

func TestHandler_DeleteGrocery(t *testing.T) {
	handler := NewTestHandler(t)
	defer handler.DB.Close()

	// First create a grocery

		"name":     "apples",
		"quantity": 5,
	}
	jsonPayload, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	createReq, err := http.NewRequest("POST", "/groceries", bytes.NewBuffer(jsonPayload))
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	createReq.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

	rr := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.CreateGrocery(rr, createReq)
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusCreated, rr.Code)

	// Now delete it
	var createdResponse GroceryResponse
	err = json.Unmarshal(rr.Body.Bytes(), &createdResponse)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	assert.NoError(t, err)

	handler.DeleteGrocery(rr, deleteReq)

	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusNoContent, rr.Code)
}

package db

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestGroceries(t *testing.T) {
	db := NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()

	// Test creating a grocery
	grocery, err := db.CreateGrocery("Apples", 5)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, "Apples", grocery.Name)
	assert.Equal(t, 5, grocery.Quantity)

	// Test listing groceries
	groceries, err := db.ListGroceries()
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Len(t, groceries, 1)
	assert.Equal(t, "Apples", groceries[0].Name)

	// Test getting a specific grocery
	grocery, err = db.GetGrocery(grocery.ID)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, "Apples", grocery.Name)

	// Test updating a grocery
	grocery, err = db.UpdateGrocery(grocery.ID, "Bananas", 10)
	assert.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, "Bananas", grocery.Name)
	assert.Equal(t, 10, grocery.Quantity)

	// Test deleting a grocery
	err = db.DeleteGrocery(grocery.ID)
	assert.NoError(t, err)

	// Test that it's gone
	grocery, err = db.GetGrocery(grocery.ID)
	assert.Error(t, err)
}

package handlers

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"grocery-api/db"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestGroceriesHandler(t *testing.T) {
	db := db.NewTestDB(t)
	defer db.Close()

	handler := NewGroceriesHandler(db)

	// Test creating a grocery
	createReq := map[string]interface{}{
		"name":     "Apples",
		"quantity": 5,
	}
	createBody, _ := json.Marshal(createReq)
	req := httptest.NewRequest("POST", "/groceries", bytes.NewBuffer(createBody))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.Create(w, req)
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusCreated, w.Code)

	// Test listing groceries
	req = httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/groceries", nil)
	w = httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.List(w, req)
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, w.Code)

	// Test getting a grocery
	req = httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/groceries/1", nil)
	w = httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.Get(w, req)
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, w.Code)

	// Test updating a grocery
	updateReq := map[string]interface{}{
		"name":     "Bananas",
		"quantity": 10,
	}
	updateBody, _ := json.Marshal(updateReq)
	req = httptest.NewRequest("PUT", "/groceries/1", bytes.NewBuffer(updateBody))
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w = httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.Update(w, req)
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, w.Code)

	// Test deleting a grocery
	req = httptest.NewRequest("DELETE", "/groceries/1", nil)
	w = httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.Delete(w, req)
	assert.Equal(t, http.StatusNoContent, w.Code)
}

package main

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"

	"grocery-api/db"
	"grocery-api/handlers"
)

func main() {
	port := os.Getenv("PORT")
	if port == "" {
		port = "8080"
	}

	db, err := db.NewDB()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer db.Close()

	groceriesHandler := handlers.NewGroceriesHandler(db)

	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /groceries", groceriesHandler.List)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /groceries/{id}", groceriesHandler.Get)
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /groceries", groceriesHandler.Create)
	mux.HandleFunc("PUT /groceries/{id}", groceriesHandler.Update)
	mux.HandleFunc("DELETE /groceries/{id}", groceriesHandler.Delete)

	log.Printf("Server starting on port %s", port)
	log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe(":"+port, mux))
}
